title: Composition baseline: Human (normal) optic nerve + optic nerve head snRNA adult-only master file (OA-D003 HRA006282, donor-level conditional reference distribution, KB2c developmental axis listed separately).
generator: build_baselines.py (KB1v2 t_16c3e020; KB2c developmental axis single column t_be336eee)

anchor.tier: T1 Annotated standard set (portal official annotations, three layers: majorclass/author_cell_type/cell_type).

t2_fields.sampling_material: Human optic nerve/optic nerve head ex vivo tissue (surgical sampling, eye bank donors; regional composition: ONH (optic nerve head/papilla) 355,363 nuclei, ON (optic nerve) 604,266 nuclei).
t2_fields.disease_stage: Normal (disease column all normal; donors were systemic death donors, donor_cause_of_death includes tumor/sepsis etc., no ocular disease records for the globe itself).
t2_fields.treatment_background: Not recorded (eye bank donation metadata lacks treatment column) — marked 'not recorded', no speculation.
t2_fields.scRNA_vs_snRNA: snRNA-seq (suspension_type=nucleus 100%; intronic_reads_counted=yes) — cannot be directly compared to scRNA cell suspension entries (e.g., D002 ocular surface).
t2_fields.enrichment_step: No sorting records (metadata lacks enrichment column; whole-tissue nuclear suspension loaded directly).
t2_fields.dissociation_method: mechanical dissociation,enzymatic dissociation×813,508 nuclei; mechanical dissociation,centrifugation×146,121 nuclei (sample_preservation=frozen in liquid nitrogen; collection=surgical resection).
t2_fields.donor_count: Primary tier adult-only 74 donors / 98 donor units; control tier adult_pool 83 donors / 107 units (includes 9 non-adult donors including newborn 15,177 nuclei → see excluded_nonadult_units row-by-row)
t2_fields.evidence_source: Local empirical recalculation (A) + CELLxGENE HRA006282 collection official annotations (portal) + Registry OA-D003.

usage_scope: Usage scope (Astra T2 adjudication fixed): This baseline = identity reference for cell composition captured by this sampling material under this experimental workflow + background control; **must not be treated as a composition compliance threshold**. Sampling subjects of disease surgical materials ≠ healthy organs (e.g., PDR fibrovascular membrane must not be validated against healthy retina composition acceptance); appearance of identities outside the annotation data list → trigger unexpected flag only, do not force change to in-list identities (label acceptance requires contextual consistency check, not whitelist positioning).

evidence_grades.A: Local empirical recalculation (with file paths + scripts)
evidence_grades.C: Empirical intervals derived from donor-level/cross-study distribution of A-grade source data
evidence_grades.qualitative: Literature provides only qualitative description → store qualitative only, do not fabricate intervals (Astra T2)
evidence_grades.not_estimable: Interval cannot be estimated — legitimate state, annotation can proceed (Astra T2)

distribution_method: Donor level (Source|Site|Donor unit); Site (ON vs ONH) × Study Source stratified first, main is aggregated adult donor units (KB2c: non-adults not merged into master file) — biological composition differences between Optic Nerve (ON) and Optic Nerve Head (ONH) are significant; when comparing, prioritize corresponding strata intervals (Astra T2); pooled is for comparison only.

fine_types.denominator_note: author_cell_type intra-class proportions (pooled within class, for reference); ON/ONH/retina suffixes = portal official location subtype annotations.

expected_low_but_present: T/B/NK/DC/Mast total <1% (immune cells sparse in normal neural tissue).
Schwann_cell 0.22% (PN myelin supporting cells; PN enrichment limited to central segment under nuclear suspension).
unexpected: Retinal neuron classes (Rod/Cone/BC/HC/AC/RGC) pooled 12.27% + RPE/pigment classes 1.17% — brought in by peripapillary retina/choroid tissue during optic disc sampling, representing capture composition rather than true optic nerve composition; do not treat this layer as 'expected proportion for optic nerve' when comparing with disease samples.
contamination_suspect: Melanocyte 0.86% (incidental leptomeningeal/pigmented tissue, slightly high within normal range, interpret in context of sampling plane).

caveats: MG=Müller glia (1.7%) and Microglia=Microglia (5.0%) are two distinct identities, coexisting in the portal vocabulary — do not mix downstream references; same rule applies to retinal abbreviations such as AC(amacrine cells)/BC(bipolar cells).

Chen (Baylor, ~85%) and Sanes (Harvard) donor pools differ vastly in size, already displayed in 4 strata by Source×Site; main gives equal weight to each donor unit, large pools no longer dominate, but inter-stratum differences require viewing strata rather than just main.
Denominator for this entry includes peripapillary retina-derived classes (~15%); for a 'pure optic nerve' reference interval, use the ON (cranial nerve II) stratum.
Comparison between snRNA scope (nuclear suspension, intronic reads counted) and scRNA data requires caution (Astra T2).

v1.1 (KB2c t_be336eee): Master file=adult-only (>=18y, adjudication Q2); v1.0 mixed scope (including newborn/3-17 years) retained in donor_level_adult_pool_contrast (tier=...__adult_pool__v1.0), identity signatures of the two tiers separated and not mixed.

sources.label: Human Optic Nerve / Optic Nerve Head Atlas, CELLxGENE collection HRA006282 (portal official annotations; registry OA-D003, verified 2026-08-11).

stage_axis.adult_rule: UBERON development_stage digital age >= 18y judged adult; explicit adult terms (late/prime/middle/mature/human adult stage, decade >=3rd) also judged adult and rule recorded; threshold changes require adjudication (KB2c Q2, 2026-09-23)
stage_axis.developing_rule: newborn/infant/postnatal stage and <18y digital age/age range → developing (KB2c Q2)
stage_axis.fetal_rule: fetal/embryonic/gestation/Carnegie terms → fetal; never merged into adult main archive (Red Line 1)
stage_axis.unknown_rule: No age column/unmapped terms/organoid/age range crossing threshold → unknown, disclosure line mandatory, silent assignment to adult prohibited (Red Line 2)
stage_axis.aging_note: >=60 elderly stratification not on this axis — aging is an orthogonal independent axis, future separate entry (adjudication Q2)
stage_axis.source_col: obs/development_stage (UBERON raw values preserved row-by-row; summary see stage_disclosure, exclusion list see excluded_nonadult_units)

90 year-old and over stage.rule: '90 year-old and over' lower bound >= threshold

development_stage_prohibition: KB3 Prohibition (PI Red Line 2026-09-23): Developmental data must not enter adult baseline statistical pool, and vice versa — same tissue fetal ≠ adult, adult/fetal do not serve as mutual references.
